sentences.text:
Shri Jitendra Kumar Jain - Advocate for the applicant
 Shri Vijay Kumar Pandey - Government Advocate for the
 respondent/State.
 Order

This is first bail application filed on behalf of applicant Atul Kumar Jain under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
2.

The applicant is in jail since 17.10.2024 in connection with Crime No.411 of 2024 registered at P.S. Themi, District- Narsinghpur for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(N) and 506 of the IPC.
3. Prosecution story in brief is that applicant repeatedly established physical relation with prosecutrix aged 32 years without her consent and against her will.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the incident is said to have occurred between 14.05.2019 and 10.11.2023 and FIR has been lodged on 23.09.2024, this huge delay in lodging FIR has not been explained.
After investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
Prosecutrix is major.
Applicant is NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:55788 2 MCRC-46112-2024 in jail from 17.10.2024.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.

sentences.text: Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.
6. Looking to the overall facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
10. Certified copy as per rules.
